title: Compute the eight run-level signals
goal: Read a loaded run and derive the eight signals brief 0002 section 7 defines. These numbers are what tell an operator whether a run was converging, so they must be computed from the run's own records rather than assumed.
acceptance: compute_signals derives every value from the records of the run it is given
iterations counts the records in iterations.jsonl
attempts burned counts records whose outcome is not done
estimated spend sums total_cost_usd across the run's sessions
A run with different records produces correspondingly different signals
